description: This file contains TypeScript source code for a Babel plugin implementation, including functions for transforming and parsing code, managing Babel plugins, and handling TypeScript-specific syntax.

methods.name: babelTransformOptions
methods.description: Generates Babel transformation options based on whether the code is TypeScript, a module, and provided plugin prologue/epilogue.

methods.name: babelTransform
methods.description: Transforms code using Babel with specified options, preventing reentrant calls.

methods.name: babelParse
methods.description: Parses code into Babel's AST using specified options.

methods.name: isTypeScript
methods.description: Checks if a filename indicates a TypeScript file based on its extension.
